map.按员工规模与心理支持需求强度（0–100），对照页面内置阈值给出基础型、标准型、: Compare headcount and support-need intensity (0–100) against the page's built-in thresholds and recommend a basic, standard or comprehensive EAP configuration.

map.全面型：员工规模 ≥500 且 需求强度 ≥60；标准型：员工规模 ≥200 或: Comprehensive: headcount >=500 and demand intensity >=60; Standard: headcount >=200 or intensity >=40; otherwise Basic. These thresholds are built-in experience values, not industry-mandated standards.
map.本页只做「按两个输入对照阈值判定档位」的分级建议，不生成资源清单、不匹配咨询师或: This page only tiers a recommendation by comparing two inputs against thresholds; it does not generate resource lists or match counsellors or hotlines. The configuration items for each tier are static suggested text for employee-care planning.
map.💡 判定阈值：规模≥500 且 强度≥60 → 全面型；规模≥200 或 强度≥: 💡 Thresholds: headcount >=500 and intensity >=60 → Comprehensive; headcount >=200 or intensity >=40 → Standard; otherwise Basic. The default inputs (800 people / 60) land in Comprehensive.
map.≥500 人（全面型条件之一）/ ≥200 人（标准型条件之一）: >=500 (one condition for Comprehensive) / >=200 (one condition for Standard)
map.本工具内置经验阈值，非行业强制标准: Built-in experience thresholds of this tool, not industry-mandated standards
map.≥60（全面型条件之一）/ ≥40（标准型条件之一），取值 0–100: >=60 (one condition for Comprehensive) / >=40 (one condition for Standard), on a 0–100 scale
map.同时满足全面条件取全面型；否则满足任一标准条件取标准型；两者皆不满足取基础型: Comprehensive if both comprehensive conditions hold; otherwise Standard if either standard condition holds; otherwise Basic

map.三档阈值为本工具内置经验值，不是行业强制标准，正式方案请结合预算与供应商报价评审: The three-tier thresholds are built-in experience values, not industry-mandated standards; review the final plan against budget and vendor quotes.

map.对比两种假设：同一规模下需求强度提升是否足以跨档（例如 800 人 / 55 为: Compare two scenarios: whether a higher demand intensity at the same headcount crosses a tier (for example 800 people / 55 is Standard, while 60 moves into Comprehensive).
map.教学演示：演示「多个条件同时满足才升档」的判定逻辑，理解档位不是规模单一决定。: Teaching demo: show the "both conditions must hold to upgrade" logic, so tiers are not decided by headcount alone.
map.员工规模 ≥500 且需求强度 ≥60，两个条件同时满足 → 判为全面型，服务包: Headcount >=500 and demand intensity >=60 both hold → Comprehensive, a 3-category service package, suggested configuration "individual counselling + 24-hour crisis response + manager training".
map.未同时满足全面型条件，但规模 ≥200 或强度 ≥40 任一成立 → 判为标准型: The comprehensive conditions are not both met, but headcount >=200 or intensity >=40 holds → Standard, a 2-category service package, suggested configuration "individual counselling + crisis referral channel".
map.规模与强度都未达到标准型门槛 → 判为基础型，服务包 1 类，建议配置为「心理宣: Neither headcount nor intensity reaches the Standard threshold → Basic, a 1-category service package, suggested configuration "psychological awareness + self-help resources".
map.三档阈值是行业标准吗？: Are the three-tier thresholds industry standards?
map.不是。500 人 / 60 与 200 人 / 40 是本工具内置的经验阈值，用: No. The 500 / 60 and 200 / 40 thresholds are built-in experience values for quick tiering and represent no mandatory standard; review the final plan against company specifics, budget and vendor quotes.
map.页面会给出咨询师名单或热线吗？: Does the page provide counsellor lists or hotlines?
map.不会。本页只做档位判定与静态配置建议，不生成资源清单、不匹配咨询师或热线，也不评: No. The page only tiers a recommendation and gives static configuration suggestions; it does not generate resource lists, match counsellors or hotlines, or assess utilisation or session counts.
